deviations.mechanism: op-revm fee distribution (the OP handler's reward_beneficiary)
deviations.reason: After every non-deposit transaction op-revm credits the base fee to its vault predeploy 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000019 with balance_incr, which touches the vault even when the amount is zero. The corpus runs with zero fees, so the vault is touched and stays empty; revm 43's mainnet handler has no vaults. EIP-161 state clearing drops a touched empty account when the state is committed (tests/claims.rs checks it), so the difference never reaches the state root. The entry stops matching once a transaction pays a non-zero fee of this kind: the vault then holds a balance and the difference must be re-attributed.
